note: Original Sub-hauler cues; source paths resolve against the Sub-hauler repository root.

entries.name: Harbor Bubbles
entries.context: Warm station / harbor cue. C major, 62.50 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 61.44 s. Falling droplet motif, offbeat replies, root/fifth bass, tiny bubble noise.

entries.name: Kelp Drift
entries.context: Unhurried submarine travel. D Dorian, 55.56 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 69.12 s. Suspended bloops, spacious answers and a quiet ballast pulse.

entries.name: Sonar Lullaby
entries.context: Deep water / sonar exploration. E minor, 50.00 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 76.80 s. Short sonar pings answer low bloops over open fifths; sparse bubble accents.

entries.name: Abyssal Glass
entries.context: Deep-water suspended drift. F# minor, 40.00 BPM, 4/4, 12 bars, 72.00 s. Long glassy calls, shallow vibrato, slow tremolo on the water voice and open-fifth ballast.

entries.name: Tidepool Waltz
entries.context: Buoyant tidepool / station interlude. G major, 75.00 BPM, 3/4, 16 bars, 38.40 s. Three-beat sway, slow triad arpeggios, duty-modulation LFO and decaying pearl bloops.

entries.name: Bubblejet Run
entries.context: Lively current-riding travel. A Dorian, 100.00 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 38.40 s. Note-cut pulse hooks, brief falling glissandos, volume-slide echoes and tiny retriggered wake rolls.
